motivation: The preregistered eager-CUDA Gate D test passed, but eleven analytic rate formulas launch many element-wise kernels. A symmetric compiler comparison is needed before claiming a robust compute advantage or promoting Task29.
promotion: Require numerically equivalent compiled exact and hybrid full 18-gate/11-current outputs and >=10% median paired latency reduction for both frozen families at batch 642. This is a separate, outcome-aware confirmation motivated by the eager result, not a retroactive amendment of its preregistration. Failure or technical non-comparability leaves Gate D incomplete and Task29 unauthorized.
limits: Only steady-state local CUDA computation; no transfers, training, full-neuron simulation, CaDynamics, passive, axial, synaptic or closed-loop dynamics. Compiler version/hardware must be reported.
